title: Lakadong Turmeric under Protected Cultivation – Part 7: Nutrient Dynamics, Fertigation, and Comparative Performance
excerpt: This article examines nutrient dynamics and fertigation strategies for Lakadong turmeric under polyhouse cultivation. It explains stage-wise nutrient demand, the relationship between mineral nutrition and curcumin biosynthesis, and the importance of controlled fertigation. The section also introduces a comparative biochemical and agronomic performance framework, visually demonstrating how Lakadong turmeric differs from common commercial turmeric types in curcumin concentration, quality consistency, and suitability for controlled cultivation systems.
